messages:
Maya Patel: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — we need an owner timeline for the vendor/auth+model-registry outage mitigations. Can folks volunteer for each action?
Sam O'Neil: I'll take the auth fallback implementation (short-term). ETA 2 weeks.
Jordan Kim: I'll own the model-registry retry/backoff work and add tests. Targeting end of sprint (10 business days).
Kevin Zhao: Can you clarify the scope for auth fallback, Sam? is this proxy-level or client SDK?
Sam O'Neil: proxy-level first (edge reverse proxy), SDK next if needed. Plan: add 2nd auth provider + circuit breaker.
Maya Patel: Sounds good. We also need calendarized QA runs and a recurring quarterly review for recurring dependency patterns.
Liya Fernandez: I'll set up the recurring review in the incidents calendar and add a checklist template for the triage owners.
incident-bot: Created event "Vendor Dependency Quarterly — Recurrence Review" on 2026-05-01 16:00 UTC. Attendees: Eng, SRE, SecOps.
Maya Patel: Action items recap: 1) Auth fallback (owner: Sam) 2) Registry retry/backoff + tests (owner: Jordan) 3) Runbook + SLA escalation doc (owner: Kevin) 4) Recurring review cadence (owner: Liya). Please append ETA and acceptance criteria in the runbook thread.
Kevin Zhao: I'll draft the SLA escalation doc this week. Acceptance criteria: documented escalation steps, pager paths, phone numbers, and a test that simulates vendor auth latency >= 2s.
Sam O'Neil: For acceptance criteria on fallback: switch within 300ms on primary failure, no dropped requests, observability metric "auth.fallback.switches" emitted. I'll link a PR once started.
Jordan Kim: Tests: unit + integration with local mock registry, and a canary deploy that validates 99% request success with 5% fault injection. Putting details into the repo issue now: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/issues/4521
Maya Patel: Good. Two more follow-ups: a) automated token TTL rotation audit (we had expired tokens last incident) b) vendor SLA renegotiation ask (ops/legal to coordinate). Who picks up rotation audit?
Kevin Zhao: I can own token rotation audit. ETA 1 week. Will add automated alert if >1% tokens near expiry without refresh.
Liya Fernandez: Ops/legal: I'll start the vendor SLA thread and loop in Contracts. Also adding a vendor contact spreadsheet to the runbook.
Maya Patel: Let's also add a short post-implementation verification playbook (commands + metrics) that on-call can run after deploys. Keep it <10 steps.
Sam O'Neil: Will add the 6-step verification for fallback to the runbook.
Jordan Kim: I'll schedule the canary and include the fault injection job.
Maya Patel: Timeline check-in next Tue 10:00 PT. If any blockers earlier, @here call it out. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
Sam O'Neil: Noted. Starting auth work tomorrow.
Kevin Zhao: Draft SLA doc in #eng-docs this afternoon.
Liya Fernandez: Calendar invite sent.
incident-bot: Incident follow-up checklist updated: https://docs.internal/redwood/incidents/followups/2362109876
